name: gas_turbine_open_cycle
title: Open-cycle gas turbine with combustion chamber and generator (TESPy tutorial)
summary: Open Brayton cycle of the TESPy basic tutorial: air compressor, diabatic combustion chamber burning a CH4/H2/CO2 fuel (species balances, excess-air ratio and lower-heating-value energy balance, ideal-gas mixture), turbine driving the compressor and a generator; the air flow follows from the imposed turbine inlet temperature, with the tutorial's efficiency/power studies over the turbine inlet temperature and the compressor pressure ratio.
language_features: user FUNCTIONs (mixture enthalpy/entropy, lower heating value)
isoperimetric isentropic relations through property calls

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors

verification.summary: Compared with a run of the TESPy tutorial gas_turbine.py: 37 common variables, max relative deviation 2.1e-03 on W_dot_cp, every other physical result <= 1.3e-03; enthalpy differences agree to 8e-04. The deviation is the gas model (real vs ideal gas).
verification.reference: TESPy tutorial gas_turbine.py run from the local snapshot (commit 19425523) in a throw-away venv (Python 3.12, TESPy 0.11.3.dev0, CoolProp 8.0.0): base case (sec_1 to sec_11) and the two sec_11 parametric sweeps, compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: 37 common variables: maximum relative deviation 2.1e-03 on W_dot_cp, every other physical result <= 1.3e-03 (m_1, eta, P_dot_grid, lambda, flue-gas mass fractions, T_2 8.9e-04, T_4 2.4e-04, ti exact); the 3 swept points of each sec_11 study agree to <= 1.3e-03 (efficiency) and 2.4e-03 (power). The absolute mixture enthalpies h_1..h_5 are excluded: TESPy uses the CoolProp HEOS species and their reference states, this model the CoolSolve ideal-gas (NASA) species (constant offset 1.52 MJ/kg on the flue gas); the enthalpy differences agree to 8e-04 (h_2-h_1 403683 vs 403999 J/kg, h_3-h_4 772244 vs 771621 J/kg). The 0.08 % difference is the gas model itself (real gas vs ideal gas), not a transcription error.
